sentence_1_it: Si dice che la vecchia cappella sia stregata.
sentence_1_en: It is said that the old chapel is haunted.
sentence_2_it: Quella cappella è stata costruita dagli spagnoli qualche secolo fa.
sentence_2_en: That chapel was built by the Spaniards some centuries ago.
sentence_3_it: Anghingò, tre galline e tre cappon', per andare alla cappella c'era una ragazza bella che suonava il ventitré, uno due tre.
sentence_3_en: Eeny, meeny, miny, moe, catch a tiger by his toe, if he hollers let him go, eeny, meeny, miny, moe. My mother told me to catch the very best one and you are not it.
